items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Marvin knew it, but he was being cool.

ctx.x: So, I started singing it and playing. You know, I didn't play the melody. I didn't have no bow to try to bow the melody, but I started singing it and playing accompaniment. It's just a waltz, you know, that Clifford got the idea what was happening. Marvin knew it, but he was being cool.
